title: E0068: Eval injection
plain_english: This rule reports code-evaluation sinks where user-controlled input reaches `eval()` or a string-based `assert()` call. This can allow arbitrary PHP code execution.
why_matters: If an attacker can control evaluated code, they may be able to execute commands, read or modify files, access data, or take control of the application environment.
what_it_checks: Cases detected through taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
